evidence.quantizer: enc_modular.cc AddVarDCTDC sets extra_dc_precision=1, uses default Weighted prediction and QuantizeWP at the default decoding speed. QuantizeWP applies dead zone 0.62, rounds small residuals at the finer step and forces larger residuals to even integers, then updates predictor state.
evidence.chroma: Native chroma DC subtracts reconstructed quantized luma through DCFactors before quantization. Our transform writer quantizes its separate DC representation before the AC luma roundtrip.
evidence.own: strategy-transplant.ts independently Math.rounds each transformed DC cell; jpegxl-jpeg-encode.ts writeDcGroup signals zero extra precision.
evidence.measurementCorrection: extractDecisions reads the assembled DC group, whose extraPrecision is normalized to zero after each raw group has already divided its coefficients by 2**precision. Read raw groups to recover the signaled flag. All 18 raw and assembled coefficient arrays match. Rendering is unaffected. No active extractor change in this round.
evidence.limit: The raw bitstream flag proves the native precision mode. Detailed nonlinear rounding is source-derived, not recovered from peer DC coefficients. Fine steps describe the grid; larger native predictor residuals are restricted to even integers. No numerical benefit or causal guard-fix claim.
